AI.tldr: Point as Skeleton 提出了一个以点云骨架为稳定条件的闭环自动驾驶生成式仿真框架，通过 Reset-and-Roll 扩散推理实现长期自回归滚动中视觉质量的稳定保持。
AI.motivation:
1. 现有仿真在闭环交互性与真实世界视觉保真度之间存在取舍（如 CARLA 交互强但视觉假，nuScenes 真实但非闭环）。
2. 直接将全序列视频生成模型用于帧级自回归滚动会因错误累积导致质量严重下降。
3. 传统重建方法在轨迹偏离后对未观测区域与动态物体的渲染可靠性不足。
AI.method:
1. 核心思路：在自回归视频生成框架中引入离线累积一次的点云骨架作为几何与外观锚点，以稳定多步滚动的视觉一致性。
2. Reset-and-Roll：适配 Diffusion-forcing 类推理到仿真接口，在每一步重置将被未来条件污染的隐状态，避免跨步状态污染。
3. 点云骨架条件：将累积点云投影为渲染平面的着色点（颜色先验）与模板深度（稳定几何先验），解耦前景与背景资产以提供一致条件。
4. nuPlan-SimGen：在 nuPlan 交通仿真内核上实现渲染层生成接口，支持 ego 从原轨迹偏离时的条件实时更新与基于投影点云的感知评估。
AI.result: 在 nuScenes 与 nuPlan benchmark 上进行闭环轨迹滚动的自回归生成评估，表明 Point as Skeleton 在多步滚动中相比基线显著提升时间一致性与视觉保真度；实验覆盖模拟器内 ego 轨迹偏离的多种情况，但未见真实世界部署验证。
AI.conclusion:
1. 核心价值：证明通过稳定几何/外观锚点可以将扩散式自回归生成稳定地嵌入闭环仿真循环，为高保真生成式仿真提供可行设计。
2. 关键限制：点云骨架需离线累积一次，且依赖稳健的在线点云跟踪与地图投影；实时仿真中条件更新若与生成速度不匹配会导致同步问题；评估局限在仿真环境，未见真实传感器-仿真域迁移测试。
3. 关键 takeaway：闭环生成式仿真的瓶颈在于条件更新的每一步如何阻止隐状态漂移，Reset-and-Roll 与骨架锚点的组合是解决该问题的有效模式。

title: CAIRN: Cross-Room 3D Scene Understanding with Topology-Aware Large Multimodal Models
summary: Existing 3D scene-grounded Large Language Models (3D-LLMs) focus on answering questions grounded in simplified single-room 3D scenes, lacking the ability to reason over real-world household environments containing multiple interconnected rooms and diverse object categories. We introduce CAIRN, a topology-aware 3D-LLM for multi-room 3D scene understanding. CAIRN aligns transformer attention with scene hierarchy, giving the model explicit awareness of object-level relations and room-level connectivity. It enriches object tokens with room-local relational context via a graph neural network, introduces learned room tokens for room-level abstraction, and applies a hierarchical attention mask with geometric bias to route information according to scene topology. CAIRN is developed on CAIRN-MR, a benchmark we introduce on HM3D for multi-room 3D scene understanding, covering grounding, captioning, and four question-answering tasks that progressively evaluate from intra-room perception to cross-room reasoning. Experiments show that CAIRN outperforms prior 3D-LLMs by a large margin across all CAIRN-MR tasks while remaining competitive on five single-room benchmarks.
full_text: Experiments sec:exp We evaluate CAIRN through four questions: 1) How is the quality of our constructed CAIRN-MR benchmark? 2) Does the hierarchical design of CAIRN 3D-LLM improve performance on cross-room reasoning tasks? 3) Does CAIRN remain effective on single-room scene understanding? 4) Which components of CAIRN are responsible for the observed gains, and for which task types? Implementation Details We use Qwen3-8B~ qwen3 as the LLM backbone, frozen and adapted via LoRA~ lora (rank 16, all attention and MLP projections); input embedding and output head are unfrozen for object identifier tokens. The graph encoder uses message-passing layers, each room is summarized by learned queries, and geometric bias is applied to the first transformer layers. Training has two stages on H200 GPUs ( 12 hours total): Stage~1 trains for 3 epochs on ScanNet tasks~ scanrefer, multi3drefer, scan2cap, scanqa, sqa3d ; Stage~2 trains for 3 epochs on 30 ScanNet and 100 CAIRN-MR. Full hyperparameters and training details are provided in Appendix~ app:appendix_hyperparams . Experiment Setup Datasets. For single-room evaluation, we use five ScanNet-based benchmarks: ScanRefer~ scanrefer and Multi3DRefer~ multi3drefer (grounding), Scan2Cap~ scan2cap (captioning), ScanQA~ scanqa (VQA), and SQA3D~ sqa3d (situated QA). For multi-room evaluation, we use CAIRN-MR ( ). Splits are partitioned at the building level with no scene overlap. Metrics. We follow standard protocols for ScanNet benchmarks: Acc@0.25/0.5 for ScanRefer, F1@0.25/0.5 for Multi3DRefer, CIDEr@0.5 and BLEU-4@0.5 for Scan2Cap, CIDEr and BLEU-4 for ScanQA, and exact match for SQA3D. For CAIRN-MR, grounding and captioning follow ScanRefer and Scan2Cap protocols. QA tasks use rule-based answer extraction, with malformed outputs scored as incorrect: Identification and Comparison are evaluated by option selection, Existence by binary accuracy, and Counting by Mean Relative Accuracy (MRA)~ vsibench . Benchmark Quality We evaluate the quality of CAIRN-MR's QA tasks along three dimensions: annotation reliability, task difficulty, and answer distribution, using three baselines ( ): Random (selects answers uniformly), Frequency (predicts the most frequent answer), and Human (3 annotators on a subset). We focus on QA tasks as they provide discrete, verifiable outputs for controlled calibration. Annotation Quality. Human performance is consistently high across tasks (86.8 --93.5 ), indicating that the annotations are reliable and that the tasks are well-defined. This suggests that performance gaps primarily reflect task difficulty rather than annotation noise. r 0.49 4pt tab:calibration lccccc & Ident. & c Count. & Exist. & Comp. \\ (lr) 3-4 & EM & EM & MRA & EM & EM \\ Random & 25.0 & 11.1 & 19.9 & 50.0 & 50.0 \\ Frequency & 25.3 & 54.7 & 62.6 & 50.0 & 48.9 \\ Human & 86.8 & 82.3 & 94.5 & 93.5 & 91.4 \\ Task Difficulty. Human performance substantially exceeds random and frequency baselines across all tasks, indicating that the tasks are non-trivial and require genuine spatial reasoning beyond surface statistics. Answer Distribution Balance. Random and frequency baselines are closely aligned on Identification, Existence, and Comparison, suggesting balanced answer distributions without dominant labels. Counting differs due to skew toward small integers (e.g., 2 accounts for 49.8 ), allowing strong frequency performance (62.6 MRA) from numerical priors rather than reasoning. This skew is intrinsic to indoor scenes~ scanqa and serves as a reference for interpreting the metric. Performance on Multi-Room Scene Understanding compares CAIRN with three representative baselines on CAIRN-MR, all trained under the same two-stage protocol with Qwen3-8B. CAIRN achieves the largest gains on grounding and captioning: +5.4 Acc@0.25/+5.4 Acc@0.5 and +14.9 CIDEr (roughly 19 relative). These improvements reflect more accurate cross-room disambiguation enabled by topology-aware modeling of room-level structure. Across QA tasks, gains scale with reliance on room-level structure. Tasks requiring cross-room reasoning (Comparison, Existence) show the largest improvements (+6.7, +3.4 EM), as they depend on reasoning across room boundaries. Counting, which enumerates objects within a localized room, shows moderate gains (+2.2 MRA), benefiting from clearer room-level scope. Identification, which only requires recognizing an object within an already localized room, remains comparable across methods (62.1 vs.\ 61.9 EM). This trend, from cross-room reasoning to within-room enumeration to object recognition, shows that CAIRN’s gains scale with the level of room-level abstraction required. The improvements are consistent across backbones with strong performance even for smaller models, showing that CAIRN remains effective under reduced model capacity. ( ). r 0.5 fig:wrap Performance on Single-Room Setting reports results on five ScanNet-based single-room benchmarks. Since these scenes contain a single room, the hierarchical structure reduces to a single level, leaving graph tokens and geometric bias as the effective components. CAIRN matches or exceeds prior methods across all benchmarks, achieving the best or second-best results on 7 of 9 metrics. These results indicate that CAIRN’s room-level components do not interfere with single-room performance. The gains are primarily driven by graph tokens and geometric bias, which encode local relational structure independent of room hierarchy, yielding improved grounding performance while maintaining competitive results across tasks. Ablation Studies sec:ablation presents an ablation on CAIRN-MR to analyze component contributions. Starting from the full model, we remove topology-aware attention (hierarchical mask and geometric bias) and structured representations (room and graph tokens), resulting in a flat baseline. Effectiveness of Topology-Aware Attention. Topology-aware attention is the primary driver of performance gains. Removing the hierarchical mask causes the largest drops across all metrics (e.g., EM on comparison, CIDEr on captioning, Acc@0.25 on grounding), as it enforces topology-aware routing of cross-room information. Without it, cross-room information flows become unconstrained, diluting room-level distinctions even when room tokens are present. The geometric bias provides consistent but smaller gains (e.g., Acc@0.25, EM) by injecting structure into attention. Effectiveness of Structured Representations. Structured representations provide complementary gains by encoding global and local context. Room tokens aggregate room-level information into compact summaries, improving captioning ( CIDEr) and comparison ( EM), while graph tokens encode local object relations, contributing gains across captioning ( CIDEr), existence ( EM), and grounding ( Acc@0.25), particularly in tasks where local context supports spatial reasoning. Gains Increase with Room-Level Reasoning. Performance gains increase with the degree of room-level reasoning required. Identification remains largely unaffected (within 1 point), as it primarily relies on recognizing objects within a localized room. Counting shows moderate degradation ( 3 points), reflecting its dependence on aggregating instances within a correctly identified room. In contrast, Existence and Comparison exhibit the largest drops ( 7--8 points), as they require reasoning across rooms and are more sensitive to disruptions in cross-room information flow. AI.tldr: 提出CAIRN，首个将场景拓扑层次显式注入大规模多模态模型的跨房间3D理解框架，打破3D-LLM的单房间性能天花板。
AI.motivation:
1. 现有3D-LLM局限于单房间场景，无法处理真实多房间家居环境的跨房间推理。
2. 对象级关系与房间级连通性的联合建模缺失，导致跨房间空间推理能力不足。
AI.method:
1. 核心思路：通过层次化注意力机制与结构化标记，将场景拓扑约束显式融入大模型推理流程。
2. 采用GNN编码对象间局部关系，生成房间上下文感知的对象表示。
3. 引入可学习房间标记实现房间级抽象与信息聚合。
4. 设计带几何偏置的层次化注意力掩码，依据房间拓扑路由跨房间信息流。
AI.result: 在自建多房间基准CAIRN-MR（覆盖grounding、captioning及4个递进式QA任务）及5个ScanNet单房间基准上验证。跨房间推理任务（Comparison、Existence）增益最大，单房间任务保持竞争力且不干扰原有性能。
AI.conclusion:
1. 核心价值：拓扑感知设计使3D-LLM首次在多房间场景实现系统性性能提升，且单房间任务零妥协。
2. 主要限制：方法依赖预定义房间分割质量；Counting任务受数值分布偏置制约，模型增益有限；缺乏真实世界复杂场景验证。
3. 关键takeaway：层次化注意力是跨房间增益的主要来源，结构化对象/房间表示提供互补增益；任务增益与所需抽象层次正相关。
